purpose: Task-local source re-attestation for the M3 product-manager review.

facts.fact: Send intent, exact Codex thread identity, immutable target binding, idempotency, and no-resend state are persisted before and after the live click boundary.
Exact target resolution and background fresh-tab recovery use full profile tab data, require the complete browser/profile/tab/session identity, and never request focus.
Capacity ownership survives atomic JSON round trips, enforces three slots per Codex task and six globally, and releases only with durable pre-click-unsent or terminal proof.

Batch manifests are contained and identity-bound; run-batch-root queues before browser work, launches existing run-root children, uses durable terminal evidence, and emits atomic results without model polling.
Atomic session allocation and batch import preserve independent task/thread/session/round identities while validating terminal watcher evidence and acknowledgements.
Session status paths are revalidated against the bound workdir, session, task, and canonical evidence roots before locked atomic evidence or response writes.
